Regex Crossword - A free online crossword puzzle based on programming logic.

For people who don't understand what Regex is, it stands for "Regular Expressions" and it's a subset language supported by almost all programming languages to match text in strings. As a basic example, if I have "PN:123" and I want to extract just the number, I might write an expression like: /PN:([0-9]+)/

  • ( and ) are called a capture. things inside are saved.
  • [ and ] are called a character class. [0-9] means "any number from 0 to 9".
  • + is called a quantifier. it means "match one or more times"

So in plain English it reads like: "match text that starts with PN: followed by one or more numbers and return the numbers that were found"
